summary: The agent assisted customer in linking Aadhaar to savings account.

intents.keywords: Hello, I want to know how to link my Aadhaar...branch help me.

issues.issue: Customer needs assistance linking Aadhaar to savings account.
issues.reason(s): Customer was not helped at the branch and is unfamiliar with the online process.

intents.actions of agent: Offered to guide the customer, provided options to visit the branch or send a form to fill out online, and offered help with filling out the form.
intents.Process Request: Send a simple form to the customer's registered email.
intents.resolution: Agent will send a form to the customer's email to link Aadhaar to the savings account.
